note: 身份：Allows the player to start Dojo challenges. 常驻： Dojo / -234, 108, -602。与玩家关系：会随阵营、任务阶段或交易状态变化。说话层次：按 Wiki 原对白的身份与情绪自然口语化，不套统一客服腔。核心性格：仅从原文呈现，不额外添加人物关系或任务事实。固定词汇/禁用：NPC 人名与自造品牌保留英文；阵营、地名和机制沿用项目术语；不硬塞网络梗。

messages.context: Master Tao：First Interaction
messages.text: Ah, who are you?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 啊,你是什么人?

messages.context: Master Tao：First Interaction
messages.text: Hmmm well, are you powerful? I enjoy watching entities display their power... or die in a pit of fire trying!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 嗯……你很强吗? 我最喜欢看人展示实力了……或者挑战失败,掉进火坑里送命!

messages.context: Master Tao：First Interaction
messages.text: Talk to me again, and I'll give you some challenges to entertain me... I mean, prove yourself.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 再跟我聊一次,我就给你几项挑战逗我开心……咳,证明你自己。

messages.context: Master Tao：First Interaction
messages.text: In fact, here's a little gift to encourage you to give it a try.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 其实,先送你点小礼物,鼓励你试试看。

messages.context: Master Tao：After Completing a Challenge / F Rank
messages.text: You  were not good enough. Come back when you've trained more.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你还不够格。练得像样点再来。

messages.context: Master Tao：D Rank
messages.text: Hardly skilled, but I'll let it pass. Come talk to me for your next challenge, and do better in the future.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 本事稀松,不过这次算你过了。来找我领取下一项挑战,下次可得表现好点。

messages.context: Master Tao：C Rank
messages.text: Rather average, I'd say. Speak to me again to try a new challenge, or improve on this one!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 只能算普普通通吧。再来找我挑战新项目,或者重试这项刷新成绩!

messages.context: Master Tao：B Rank
messages.text: That was pretty good! Please come by again for a new challenge.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 表现不错! 下次再来接受新挑战吧。

messages.context: Master Tao：A Rank
messages.text: Wow, that was really impressive. Come talk to me to view your next challenge.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 嚯,确实很精彩。来找我看看下一项挑战。

messages.context: Master Tao：S Rank
messages.text: That was a remarkable performance! I look forward to giving you your next challenge.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这场表现相当出色! 我都等不及给你下一项挑战了。

messages.context: Master Tao：Teleporting to Arena
messages.text: Ahhh, here we go! Let's get you into the Arena.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 好——要开始了! 我送你进竞技场。

messages.context: Master Tao：Waiting for a Challenge to Start
messages.text: Have patience, I'm getting you in right now!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 耐心点,这就送你进去!

messages.context: Master Tao：Attempting a Disabled Challenge
messages.text: It is not safe to do that challenge right now. Come back later!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 现在进行这项挑战不安全。晚点再来!

messages.context: Master Tao：With Items
messages.text: I only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've stored your items away.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我只考验不借外物的真本事。不许带任何帮手! 把物品全存好再来。

segments.text: I only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've
segments.zh: 我只考验不借外物的真本事。不许带任何帮手! 把

messages.raw: §fI only test people who use their bare skills. No extra help allowed! Come back to me once you've §estored your items away§f.

messages.context: Master Tao：With Only Equipment
messages.text: Your inventory includes your equipment too! Make sure that is cleared!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 装备栏也算背包的一部分! 一件都不能留!

segments.text: too! Make sure that is cleared!
segments.zh: 也算背包的一部分! 一件都不能留!

messages.context: Master Tao：Whilst Mounted on a Pet
messages.text: No pets allowed in the dojo! Get off of your pet.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 道场不许骑宠物! 快从宠物身上下来。

messages.context: Master Tao：Sent by Ugo / First Interaction
messages.text: Ugo is that you?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Ugo,是你吗?

messages.context: Master Tao：Sent by Ugo / First Interaction
messages.text: You missed yesterday's lesson.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你昨天旷课了。

messages.context: Master Tao：Sent by Ugo / First Interaction
messages.text: And the one before that.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 前天也旷了。

messages.context: Master Tao：Sent by Ugo / First Interaction
messages.text: So today you'll have to do three lessons.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 所以今天你得补上三堂课。
messages.raw: So today you'll have to do §7three §flessons.

segments.text: So today you'll have to do

messages.context: Master Tao：Sent by Ugo / First Interaction
messages.text: The first one is a Test of Force.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 第一项是力量试炼。
messages.raw: The first one is a §2Test of Force§f.

messages.context: Master Tao：Sent by Ugo / First Interaction
messages.text: Go in the Arena.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 进竞技场。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Force
messages.text: Humph. This will do for now.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 哼。暂时算你过了。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Force
messages.text: Onto the next Test, Stamina this time.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 下一项试炼,这次考耐力。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Stamina
messages.text: You are not performing that well today, but I'll accept that score for today.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 今天表现不怎么样,不过这个分数我先收下。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Stamina
messages.text: One more test before I let you go. The Test of Mastery.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 再过一项就放你走。精通试炼。
messages.raw: One more test before I let you go. The §2Test of Mastery§f.

segments.text: One more test before I let you go. The

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Mastery
messages.text: Well done Ugo, you finished your training for today.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 不错,Ugo,今天的训练完成了。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Mastery
messages.text: Remember Ugo, I can show you the path but I can not walk it for you.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 记住,Ugo,我能给你指路,但不能替你走。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Mastery
messages.text: If you want to make your father proud you will have to train more than it is expected of you.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 想让你父亲为你骄傲,就得练得比别人要求的更多。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Mastery
messages.text: Respect your training and you will respect yourself.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 尊重你的训练,才会尊重你自己。

messages.context: Master Tao：Completing the Test of Mastery
messages.text: Go now.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 去吧。

messages.context: Master Tao：None
messages.text: Make sure you empty your inventory entirely before you enter.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 进去之前,务必把背包彻底清空。

messages.context: Master Tao：Attempting to Enter Arena With Items
messages.text: Ugo! You know very well you need to store all your items away before you enter the Arena.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: Ugo! 你明明知道进竞技场前必须把所有物品都存起来。

messages.context: Master Tao：Failing a Test
messages.text: This isn't good enough Ugo! Your father would be very annoyed if I told him the score you got!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 这成绩可不行,Ugo! 要是我告诉你父亲,他准得气坏了!

messages.context: Master Tao：Failing a Test
messages.text: Go back inside and do better!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 回去重来,给我做得更好!

messages.context: 完成道场挑战后的奖励说明
messages.text: After completing our challenges you will get various rewards, including different colored belts.
messages.zh: 完成挑战后,你会获得各种奖励,包括各色腰带。

messages.context: 道场挑战失败后的评价
messages.text: You were not good enough. Come back when you've trained more.
messages.zh: 你还不够强。多练练再来吧。
